scope: Supplementary four-world portfolio-high attempt plus twelve exact archived outcomes on four familiar seed blocks. Original interrupted panel remains incomplete. Contrasts are conditional on supplementary execution, not an uninterrupted factorial or promotion.
limitations: The architecture factor includes the whole retained portfolio package, including future/payment choices.
Convention changes the entire derived bundle ladder and the existing modeled saving, not only a single posted opening fee. Solo payment and existing open-anchor schedules are retained.
Four blocks provide weak uncertainty and qualification evidence. More posts do not increase the independent sample size.
No counterfactual driver outcomes are inferred from unchosen fees. Whole-week random worlds capture the policy-dependent event trajectory.
Supplementary runs were predeclared after observing original operational failures. They do not erase failures, add independent seed blocks, or establish runtime reliability.
decision: Use these four development blocks to assess the payment confound and choose the next structural experiment. No promotion: the original operational failures, small sample, familiar seeds and whole-package architecture factor limit attribution and reliability claims.
